find: report: report == null ? join(dirname(outPath), REPORT_BASENAME) : resolve(report),
why: Restores issue #637 exactly: an omitted --report resolves its bare basename against the WORKING DIRECTORY instead of following the frame, so `npm run screens --out somewhere/frame.png` drops producer.json in the repository root, where .gitignore does not cover it (its scratch entries are root-anchored at /tmp/ and /scratchpad/) and the next `git add -A` commits it. That happened twice before the fix. Invisible to the capture framework, which is the trap: tools/capture/screen-adapter.mjs passes --report explicitly, so every FRAMEWORK capture reads identically under this mutation and only a hand-run is affected -- the reason the defect survived as long as it did. KILLED BY 3, MEASURED: the repo-root invariant, the beside-the-frame case, and the absolute-out case. An earlier draft of this note declared 1 and argued the invariant case could not catch it; that was wrong in the informative direction and is recorded rather than quietly corrected. The invariant DOES catch it, because with no --out given the frame still defaults under tmp/ while the mutated report resolves to the root -- so the two artifacts separate, which is precisely the state the invariant forbids. The two cases that survive are the right ones: pins-the-destination reads --out only, and honours-an-explicit-report is the negative control proving this entry is about the DEFAULT rather than about resolution generally.
